name: Watercolor Storybook: Character Headshot
description: Image preset for a character headshot in the Watercolor Storybook look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for a headshot. Lead with the character's defining facial features, hair, and expression from the entity, then apply the style. Keep the background plain.
context_prompt: head-and-shoulders portrait of the character, face fills the frame, eyes sharp, neutral background that does not compete, watercolour picture-book illustration, soft pencil line, loose washes that bleed past the line, visible paper texture, gentle rounded shapes, pastel palette, soft daylight, white paper showing through the highlights
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, harsh black outlines, neon colours, dark horror mood, text, watermark
